title: Already Settled
description: Once an invoice is paid, it should be closed for business — a second payment attempt against it is a mistake, not a valid retry.
successCondition: Create an invoice and pay it successfully with a well-formed card number that isn't one of the mock gateway's decline/timeout numbers (invoice status becomes "paid"). A second POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay against that same invoice, with any card number, returns 409 with error.code CONFLICT and no new Payment record is created — GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/payments still shows only the one successful attempt.
hints: Any card number other than 4000000000000002 and 4000000000000119 succeeds deterministically, per docs/api/billing.md's mock gateway table.
Check the payments count before and after the second attempt to prove the 409 truly short-circuited before creating a Payment row.
